Audience: first-time North Carolina applicants preparing for the regular Class C knowledge test, in English, including teens who face stricter under-21 alcohol rules [A03].
Level: precise recall of decimal BAC limits, time windows and penalty ladders; high confusion risk between similar numbers, so contrast drills matter.
Prerequisites: the graduated licensing section, which introduces the provisional licensee alcohol rule; the licensing section, which defines commercial versus regular classes.
Sensitivity: penalties are legal content stated exactly as printed; the dossier gives no legal advice.
